battle.name: 愛爾蘭獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年1月21日索羅黑德貝格伏擊揭開戰端，愛爾蘭武裝以小隊游擊與夜間突襲對抗英軍。英軍以李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 步槍配刺刀與栓式機槍據守城鎮與營房，愛方則大量奪取同型步槍、彈藥與輕機槍武裝游擊隊，雙方在同一種栓式步槍的射程與射界內周旋，最終逼出1921年的停火協議。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 步槍
kit.history: 該步槍是英國在第一次世界大戰中的主力栓式步槍，於愛爾蘭獨立戰爭期間被英軍與愛爾蘭武裝廣泛使用。

countries: 交戰一方是英國及其在愛爾蘭的統治機構：駐愛爾蘭英軍部隊、皇家愛爾蘭警察隊，以及招募自英國本土的輔助人員（Auxiliaries，即俗稱的黑棕隊）與臨時混合編制。英方最高指揮由駐愛爾蘭總督麥克雷迪爵士兼任駐軍總司令，下轄駐愛英軍指揮官麥克斯韋爾將軍，各郡設守備區與巡邏縱隊，重要城鎮與港口由英軍步兵營、機槍排與裝甲車巡邏隊控制。另一方是愛爾蘭共和軍與愛爾蘭共和邦政府：IRA 最高指揮部之下設愛爾蘭各地師旅，鄉村以科克第一、二、三旅等為骨幹，另有專責城市破壞與暗殺的旅別；共和邦國會在一九一九年一月成立後宣示獨立，宣稱自己是唯一合法政府，並把 IRA 游擊隊解釋為正式國軍而非匪類，這一定位使英方在法律與政治上難以用普通治安手段從事鎮壓。整場衝突的結構性矛盾正來源於此：英方以正規軍、鐵路、港口據點與傳統通信控制鄉村，IRA 則以分散的小分隊、流動的武器庫與地方人脈網絡，使英軍的兵力優勢難以轉化為控制力。英方自一九二〇年起增調後備兵與輔助兵，設立以情報主導的特別行動編制，在科克、凱里、蒂珀雷里等重點鄉村部署成建制連、輕機槍排與裝甲車巡邏線；IRA 則在每個鄉鎮維持小型秘密武器庫，倚靠農舍、修院與山間通道構成藏身與補給網。雙方都沒有取得決定性突破，戰局因此在三年內維持消耗與試探的形態。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were, on the one hand, the British state and its instruments in Ireland: the British Army forces stationed in Ireland, the Royal Irish Constabulary, and auxiliary personnel recruited from Britain (the Auxiliaries, popularly known as the Black and Tans) organised into ad hoc mixed units. On the British side the supreme command combined the Lord Lieutenant of Ireland with the Commander-in-Chief, while the General Officer Commanding the troops in Ireland, Sir John Maxwell, ran the district and patrol columns in every county, the key towns and ports being held by infantry battalions, machine-gun sections and armoured car patrols. The other side was the Irish Republican Army and the Irish Republic. At the top of the IRA stood a supreme directorate, and beneath it the numbered brigades and divisions; in the countryside the backbone was the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Cork Brigades, with separate brigades responsible for urban intelligence, assassinations and sabotage. After the Dáil Éireann was constituted in January 1919 and proclaimed independence, it claimed to be the only lawful government of Ireland and insisted that the IRA was an army of the Republic rather than a band of rebels, a position that left the British authorities with awkward legal and political problems when they tried to treat the rising as ordinary disorder. The structural contradiction of the war grew out of that asymmetry: Britain tried to hold the countryside with regular troops, railways, port bases and a conventional communications network, while the IRA countered with small bands, hidden dumps and a web of local contacts that made British numerical superiority impossible to convert into control. From 1920 London reinforced Ireland with reserves and auxiliaries and created intelligence-led special operations units, deploying company-strength columns, light machine-gun sections and armoured car screens across the key districts of Cork, Kerry and Tipperary. The IRA in turn kept small secret dumps in every parish and relied on farmhouses, friaries and mountain tracks for hiding and supply. Neither side achieved a decisive breakthrough, so the conflict settled into a three-year contest of attrition and probing.
people: 英方關鍵人物包括駐愛爾蘭總督兼駐軍總司令麥克雷迪爵士、駐愛英軍指揮官麥克斯韋爾將軍，以及皇家愛爾蘭警察隊總監休・都督，三人構成一九一九至一九二〇年間英方決策核心：麥克斯韋爾主張在科克等重點區集中兵力搜索，麥克雷迪則傾向以政治與懷柔手段爭取愛爾蘭民眾，兩種取向在都柏林的逮捕與清剿行動中屢見張力。愛方最關鍵者是國會總統埃蒙・德瓦萊拉，他於一九一九年一月當選共和邦國會主席，既任 IRA 最高情報主任，也是拒絕英方懷柔談判的旗幟；情報主任麥可・柯林斯掌握武裝的實際運作，並代表愛方出席停火談判，是一九二一年九月停火協議的主要設計者。作戰主任卡塔爾・布魯哈在索羅黑德貝格伏擊中腿部中彈仍不退下，維持了南部早期行動的銳氣；尚恩・麥克恩率領該次伏擊，被視為 IRA 鄉村游擊的象徵；參謀總長理查德・穆爾卡希統管全境支部運作，並在停火後主張把游擊隊改組為常備國防軍。科克市長特倫斯・麥克思維尼一九二〇年八月被捕後在倫敦監獄絕食至死，引發全國騷動與一波城市暗殺。地方支部首腦同樣關鍵，蒂珀雷里的支部在 1919 年拒絕解散，令該郡成為全國游擊最密集的地區。停火談判的最後一幕，是德瓦萊拉與英方代表的會面引發共和邦內部對批准與否的分裂，最終演成一九二二年至一九二三年的內戰。
peopleEn: British key figures were the Lord Lieutenant and Commander-in-Chief Sir Nevil Macready, the General Officer Commanding the troops in Ireland, Sir John Maxwell, and the head of the Royal Irish Constabulary, Hugh Tudor; together they formed the core of British decision-making between 1919 and 1920. Maxwell favoured concentrating troops and sweeping the hard areas such as Cork, while Macready leaned towards political conciliation and winning Irish opinion, and the tension between the two approaches surfaced repeatedly in the arrests and clearances carried out in Dublin. On the Irish side the central figure was Éamon de Valera, elected President of the Dáil in January 1919, who served as the IRA Director of Intelligence and became the symbol of refusal to negotiate with London. His intelligence chief, Michael Collins, ran the practical machinery of the armed organisation, represented the Irish side at the truce negotiations and was the principal architect of the agreement of September 1921. Cathal Brugha, the Director of Operations, was shot in the leg during the Soloheadbeg ambush yet kept the early momentum of the southern campaign alive; Seán Mac Eoin led that ambush and became the emblem of rural guerrilla action. Richard Mulcahy, the Chief of Staff, ran the network of brigades across the country and after the truce pressed for the transformation of the guerrillas into a standing national army. Terence MacSwiney, Lord Mayor of Cork, was arrested in August 1920 and died on hunger strike in a London prison, setting off nationwide disorder and a new wave of urban assassinations. Local leaders mattered just as much: the Tipperary brigades refused to disband in 1919, which made that county the most heavily penetrated part of the country. The final act of the negotiation, the meeting between de Valera and the British representatives, split the Dáil over whether the treaty should be accepted, and that split erupted into civil war in 1922 and 1923.
kits: 全場戰爭的核心兵器是李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 步槍（No. 1 Mk III，又稱短彈匣李-恩菲爾德），一九〇七年式栓式步槍，.303 口徑（7.7×56 公厘）、十發可拆卸彈匣、槍身長約一一三〇公厘、連刺刀約四公斤，以機械瞄具瞄射，有效射程一般以六百至八百公厘計。英軍各步兵營以它作為標準槍械，皇家愛爾蘭警察隊的武裝警察同樣配發此槍，機關槍支援則以維克斯與馬克辛重機槍為主。IRA 一方大量依賴同型槍械：一九一四年四月拉恩港一次登陸的軍械中，據一般研究記載約有三萬五千支配用步槍連同約九十萬發 .303 彈藥，另有大量手槍與輕重機槍，該批軍械原本分發予北愛爾蘭義勇軍，其後相當部分流入愛爾蘭武裝；一九一六年豪斯進槍案亦有數千支毛瑟步槍與彈藥上陸。一九二一年英方更同意售予共和邦約二萬支配用步槍、約九十萬發 .303 彈藥與一批 Lewis 輕機槍，部分於同年七月抵岸。IRA 另配備韋利 .455 左輪手槍、勃朗寧 .45 手槍、少量 Thompson 衝鋒槍與自製炸藥包；英軍則以裝甲車、軍用卡車、機車與飛機支援巡邏與偵察。鄉村游擊隊在隱蔽、機動與射擊紀律上佔優，卻在重火力與補給上全面落後，這一落差正是整場消耗戰的結構所在。
kitsEn: The weapon at the centre of the whole war was the Lee-Enfield No. 1 Mk III, the 1907 pattern bolt-action rifle known as the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield: .303 British (7.7×56mm) calibre, a ten-round detachable magazine, an overall length of roughly 1,130mm and about four kilograms with the bayonet, sighted with plain military sights and credited with an effective range of six hundred to eight hundred metres. British infantry battalions carried it as their standard arm, the armed police of the Royal Irish Constabulary were issued with the same rifle, and machine-gun support rested on the Vickers and Maxim heavy guns. On the IRA side the same rifle was in enormous supply: the arms landed at Larne in April 1914 are generally recorded as about 35,000 service rifles with around 900,000 rounds of .303 ammunition, together with quantities of pistols and light and heavy machine guns. That consignment was originally distributed to the Ulster Volunteer Force, and a substantial part later passed into the hands of Irish republican gunmen; the Howth gun-running of 1916 added several thousand Mauser rifles and their ammunition. In 1921 the British government further agreed to sell the Republic about 20,000 service rifles, some 900,000 rounds of .303 ammunition and a quantity of Lewis light machine guns, part of which landed in July of that year. The IRA also used Webley .455 revolvers, Browning .45 pistols, a few Thompson submachine guns and improvised explosive charges, while the British relied on armoured cars, lorries, motorcycles and aircraft to screen their patrols and gather intelligence. The rebels were superior in concealment, mobility and shooting discipline but hopelessly outmatched in heavy firepower and supply, and that imbalance is what made the war a war of attrition.
tactics: IRA 的戰術核心是小型游擊與打了就跑的襲擊，通常以四至八人小組行動，選定公路彎道、涵洞、採石場與山口設伏，於黃昏或夜間開火，隨即解散重組，使英軍難以反制搜索。郡級支部之間建立縱隊與傳令網，以流動的武裝縱隊往返於郡界之間，一夜之間可轉移數十公里；一九二〇年後更出現以旅為單位的地方控制，由支部在自己地盤巡邏、徵收糧食並維持秩序。基爾肯尼至科克之間約五十公里的一段分界線被雙方默契地視為禁區，IRA 與英軍均不在其上活動，以免引發雙邊交火，這段黑線成為當時游擊地理的鮮明特徵。IRA 亦以縱火摧毀警察局所與英軍營房，令對方失去站崗與報案節點，並以暗殺手段針對情報人員與軍官。英方則以營級清剿作戰回應：先以裝甲車與飛機偵察，再以步兵縱隊合圍鄉鎮作逐戶搜索，夜間行軍多採不出聲的集結方式，並在南部反覆進行掃蕩；一九二〇年秋冬更在都柏林一帶進行大規模逮捕與官方制裁，試圖以情報主導的鎮壓切斷支部之間的聯繫。雙方都避免會戰，最終由長期消耗與地方僵持導向停火談判。
tacticsEn: The heart of the IRA method was small-scale ambush and the deliberate avoidance of a set-piece battle. Bands of four to eight men picked the bends of roads, culverts, quarries and mountain passes, opened fire at dusk or in the dark, and then scattered to re-form, denying the British any target to fix and punish. Brigades were linked by a communications and courier network, and mobile columns of armed men moved across county boundaries, sometimes covering tens of kilometres in a single night; by 1920 some brigades had established effective local control, patrolling their own districts, provisioning them and keeping order. A stretch of some fifty kilometres between Kilkenny and Cork came to be treated by tacit agreement as a forbidden line on which neither the IRA nor the British would operate, to avoid a clash that neither side wanted, and this Black Line became a distinctive feature of the guerrilla geography of the time. The IRA also burned police stations and British barracks, depriving the other side of its posts and its reporting points, and it assassinated intelligence officers and commanders. The British answered with battalion-level clearance operations: armour and aircraft first for reconnaissance, then infantry columns encircling villages and searching house by house, with night marches conducted as silent concentrations; in the autumn and winter of 1920 they mounted large arrests and official reprisals in Dublin and nearby districts, attempting to break the link between the IRA and the countryside. Neither side sought a decisive engagement, and the long grind of mutual exhaustion and local stalemate eventually pushed both parties towards negotiation.
data: 時間上，戰爭自一九一九年一月二十一日索羅黑德貝格伏擊起，至一九二一年十二月十一日停火，共約三十五個月，談判則在一九二一年九月簽署停火協議後展開。人數方面，據一般研究估計，英軍駐愛兵力由一九一九年初的一萬餘人增至一九二一年高峰時的五萬人上下，輔助兵另約一萬人，皇家愛爾蘭警察隊約一萬四千人；IRA 在共和邦文件中曾宣稱武裝人數超過十五萬，但實際活躍作戰人數的峰值一般估計僅數千人，約三千至四千人。軍械數量亦可部分核對：一九一四年拉恩港軍械載運約三萬五千支步槍與約九十萬發 .303 彈藥；一九二一年英方同意交付約二萬支步槍及九十萬發彈藥；李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 全長約一一三〇公厘、槍重約四公斤、彈匣十發、標稱有效射程六百至八百公厘；黑線全長約五十公里。傷亡方面，各家統計出入頗大，一般認為 IRA 陣亡者約七百五十至一千人，英軍與警察陣亡者合計約四百至五百人。作戰次數與破壞規模則常以數百次襲擊、數十座英軍營房被焚毀來概括，具體數字在地方報紙與官方檔案之間互有出入，諸說並存。
dataEn: On timing, the war ran from the Soloheadbeg ambush of 21 January 1919 to the ceasefire of 11 December 1921, about thirty-five months in all, with formal negotiations opening after the agreement of September 1921. On numbers, general research puts British troops in Ireland rising from a little over ten thousand in early 1919 to roughly fifty thousand at the peak in 1921, with about ten thousand auxiliaries and some fourteen thousand Royal Irish Constabulary constables; the IRA claimed in Republic documents to have more than one hundred and fifty thousand men under arms, but the strength actually engaged in operations is generally estimated in the low thousands, around three to four thousand at the high point. Part of the material figures can be checked: the Larne shipment of 1914 carried about 35,000 rifles and 900,000 rounds of .303 ammunition, and the British agreed in 1921 to hand over roughly 20,000 rifles and 900,000 rounds; the Lee-Enfield No. 1 Mk III itself measures some 1,130mm, weighs about four kilograms, holds ten rounds in the magazine and is credited with a service effective range of six hundred to eight hundred metres, and the Black Line ran for about fifty kilometres. Casualty figures vary widely between sources; the usual reading is that between seven hundred and fifty and a thousand IRA members were killed, while British soldiers and police killed amounted to some four hundred to five hundred. The scale of operations is usually summarised as several hundred attacks and the burning of dozens of British barracks, but the precise counts differ between local newspapers and official files, and the record is genuinely uncertain.
cause: 戰爭的起因可上溯至一九一六年復活節起義及其後的鎮壓。一九一八年英國《徵兵法》延伸到愛爾蘭，強徵愛爾蘭青年入伍，英軍佔領部分城鎮並沒收報紙，觸發全國性的政治不滿；同年德國陰謀被破獲，使愛爾蘭人普遍相信英方在勾結敵人。一九一八年十二月大選中，共和派贏得一百零三席中的七十三席，選民以選票委託了一套從議會鬥爭轉向武裝鬥爭的方案。一九一九年一月二十一日，共和邦國會在都柏林開會並宣示獨立，IRA 同日發表開戰聲明，愛爾蘭內戰在法律上與實務上同時展開。英方的回應則把衝突釐定為治安問題：禁止國會集會、查封報館、逮捕支部書記，並在一九一九年下半年對被捕的 IRA 分子採用絞刑，令鄉村抵抗更為激烈。土地與經濟因素亦難以分割：戰時通脹、糧食短缺與農地分配的不公，使地方支部得以在日常人際網絡中迅速召集人手。
causeEn: The origins of the war lie in the Easter Rising of 1916 and the repression that followed. The British Conscription Act was extended to Ireland in 1918, conscripting Irish men into the army, while British troops occupied several towns and suppressed newspapers, producing a national mood of political grievance; the discovery of a German plot in the same year convinced many Irishmen that London was in secret contact with the enemy. In the general election of December 1918 the republican party took seventy-three of the hundred and three Irish seats, and the voters used the ballot to entrust a programme that had moved from parliamentary struggle towards armed struggle. On 21 January 1919 the Dáil met in Dublin and proclaimed independence, the IRA published its declaration of war the same day, and the civil war began in law and in practice at once. The British response framed the conflict as a policing problem: the Dáil was banned, newspapers were seized, organisers were arrested, and in the second half of 1919 captured IRA men were hanged, which sharpened rural resistance still further. Land and economic questions cannot be separated from the political one: wartime inflation, food shortages and unequal distribution of farmland made it possible for local branches to mobilise men quickly through everyday networks of acquaintance.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是英愛關係的根本重排。英國於一九二〇年通過《愛爾蘭政府法》，將愛爾蘭分為 Northern Ireland 與仍在英國管治下的南部；愛方在南部成功建立一套與英國平行的行政與立法體系，國會的官員、法令與徵稅在游擊戰期間持續運作，讓一個未獲承認的共和國在戰時仍然存在。這種以武裝鬥爭逼迫政治讓步的模式，成為二十世紀初多數殖民地反叛的樣板，也直接影響英國隨後在伊拉克、巴勒斯坦與愛爾蘭自身的應對方式。對英軍與愛爾蘭社會而言，長期分散的鄉村戰爭暴露了常備軍在無邊界控制上的弱點，也迫使英國在 1921 年接受談判。愛方內部則出現路線分裂：主張接受條約者與拒絕條約者對立，一九二二年至一九二三年的內戰隨之爆發；愛爾蘭民族黨於一九二六年成立並在一九三二年執政，導向一九三七年憲法與一九四九年宣布共和國。戰爭留下的政治記憶、紀念儀式與武裝傳統，長期影響共和國與北愛爾蘭的政治文化與雙方關係。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the war was a fundamental reordering of the British-Irish relationship. The British Government of Ireland Act of 1920 divided Ireland into Northern Ireland and a southern part that remained under British rule, while on the southern side the Irish built an administrative and legislative system parallel to the British one: the officials, decrees and taxation of the Dáil continued to operate through the guerrilla years, so that an unrecognised republic existed in practice even while fighting for survival. The pattern of using armed struggle to force political concession became a model for colonial rebellions across the early twentieth century, and it shaped British conduct in Iraq, Palestine and Ireland itself in the years that followed. For the army and for Irish society, a long scattered rural war exposed the weakness of a regular army in endless counter-insurgency, and it was one of the reasons London accepted talks in 1921. Within the Irish movement the war also produced a strategic split: those who would accept the treaty against those who refused, a division that erupted into civil war between 1922 and 1923. Fianna Fáil was founded in 1926, won power in 1932, and carried Ireland through the 1937 constitution to the declaration of the Republic in 1949. The political memory, commemorative ritual and armed tradition left by the war continue to shape the political culture and the relationship between the two states.
result: 結局是談判而不是戰勝。一九二一年九月十一日英愛簽訂停火協議，十二月十一日零時起全面停火；十二月六日簽署的《英愛條約》規定英國承認愛爾蘭自由邦的獨立地位，同時要求國會接受國君與英國王室的權力，埃蒙・德瓦萊拉認為條約與共和國憲法不容並存，遂退出國會並拒絕率眾批准。共和邦內部因此分裂，一九二二年六月爆發內戰，雙方武裝人員陣亡數百人，一般統計落在七百至一千人之間，具體數字有分歧，至一九二三年四月大局底定，自由邦得以於一九二二年十二月六日成立。愛方獲得了在自己領土上的完全主權、國防與財政，卻沒有取得 Northern Ireland，也未能解決宣誓與國君問題；英軍以和平方式撤出多數據點，也保留了北愛的行政架構。愛爾蘭其後用二十年時間以憲法手段處理爭議，最終在一九三七年落實全面主權的憲制，並於一九四九年結束與英國的關係，成為今天的 Republic of Ireland；戰爭本身則以停火與條約，把一場未竟的軍事衝突轉化為一段尚未完成的憲政過程。
resultEn: The war ended in negotiation rather than victory. A truce was signed on 11 September 1921 and the ceasefire took effect at midnight on 11 December; the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 6 December 1921 recognised the independence of the Irish Free State, but required the Dáil to accept the authority of the crown and of the British monarch, and Éamon de Valera judged that a treaty was incompatible with the constitution of the republic, so he withdrew from the Dáil and refused to lead the ratification. The Republic split in two, civil war broke out in June 1922, several hundred fighters on both sides were killed — the usual estimates fall between seven hundred and a thousand — and by April 1923 the issue was settled, with the Free State established on 6 December 1922. The Irish achieved full sovereignty on their own territory, with defence and finance in their own hands, but gained neither Northern Ireland nor a settlement of the oath and the crown; the British evacuated most of their posts peacefully and kept the administrative structure of the north. Ireland then spent two decades settling the dispute by constitutional means, securing complete sovereignty in the 1937 constitution and ending the legal relationship with Britain in 1949 with the Republic of Ireland. The war itself resolved not into a military conclusion but into a ceasefire and a treaty, converting an unfinished military conflict into an unfinished constitutional process.
